card.capacity_status_quote: Strong customer demand across workloads, customer segments, and geographic regions continues to exceed available capacity.
card.demand_direction_quote: Strong execution and improving product quality drove accelerating Microsoft 365 Copilot seat adds this quarter, with paid seats now over 20 million.
card.pricing_power_quote: And earlier this week, we announced our move to a usage-based pricing model for GitHub Copilot as we align pricing to actual usage and cost.
card.guidance_direction_quote: We expect CapEx spend to increase to over $40 billion as we continue to bring more capacity online.
card.constraint_owner_quote: Even with these additional investments and continued efforts to bring GPU, CPU, and storage capacity online faster, we expect to remain constrained at least through 2026.
